name: Natsusawa Remi
source:
Born on July 14, 1989.
Member of the Tennis club. She was born in July. Has distinctive short hair parted to both sides. Her favorite food is melons, and her favorite color is orange. She's aware of current trends and gossip. She is good friends with [url=/c136094]Amaike Mami[/url] and [url=/c136095]Shirakoma Kumi[/url], often seen hanging out together.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/3年B組金八先生_伝説の教壇に立て!]Wikipedia[/url]]
